newsitem.title: UK: Natl Grid rejigs transmission, moves Gibson.
newsitem.headline: Natl Grid rejigs transmission, moves Gibson.

text.p: British power utility National Grid Plc said on Tuesday it would streamline the management of its core transmission function and in doing so move director Colin Gibson off the board.

Under a new organisation, transmission managing director Roger Urwin will head a group covering system management, project management, network services, engineering, commercial and system strategy, National Grid said.
Colin Gibson will head up the latter function and his new responsibilities will including system development and investment planning.
He would step down from the board at the end of January, the firm added in a statement.
